name: Claudepy Android Build-Test Cycle
description: End-to-end Android dev loop orchestrator for claudepy: assemble → install → instrumented-test → log scrape → triage. Encodes the proven Gradle + ADB cadence so iterations stop dropping commands between turns.
content:
# Claudepy Android Build-Test Cycle

You are orchestrating one **build → install → test → triage** loop for an Android project from claudepy. Every step is deterministic — run them in order, capture exit codes, and stop the cycle on the first hard failure.

## Inputs
- **Project root:** {{android_project_root}}
- **Module:** {{module}} (e.g. `app`, `wear`, `feature:auth`)
- **Variant:** {{variant}} (e.g. `debug`, `staging`, `release`)
- **Device serial:** {{device_serial}} (output of `adb devices -l` first column; use `auto` to pick the only connected device)
- **Test scope:** {{test_scope}} (`unit` | `instrumented` | `both` | `none`)
- **Test filter:** {{test_filter}} (Gradle `--tests` glob, e.g. `*LoginViewModel*`; `all` to run the full suite)
- **Iteration goal:** {{iteration_goal}} (one sentence — "land green build with feature X" or "reproduce crash Y")

---

## Phase 0 — Sanity check ☑️

Run these first; abort the cycle if any fail.

```bash
cd {{android_project_root}}
[ -f gradlew ] || { echo 'No gradlew — wrong directory'; exit 2; }
./gradlew --version | head -3
adb version | head -1

if [ '{{device_serial}}' = 'auto' ]; then
  DEVICE=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}')
else
  DEVICE='{{device_serial}}'
fi
[ -n "$DEVICE" ] || { echo 'No device connected'; exit 3; }
adb -s "$DEVICE" shell getprop ro.product.model
```

Record `$DEVICE` for every subsequent `adb` call.

---

## Phase 1 — Clean state (optional) 🧹

Only run when iteration_goal mentions "clean", "fresh", or "reproduce from scratch".

```bash
./gradlew :{{module}}:clean
adb -s "$DEVICE" uninstall $(./gradlew -q :{{module}}:printApplicationId 2>/dev/null | tail -1) || true
```

Skip otherwise — incremental builds are 10–30× faster.

---

## Phase 2 — Assemble 🔨

```bash
./gradlew :{{module}}:assemble{{variant^}} \
  --build-cache --parallel --configure-on-demand \
  -Dorg.gradle.jvmargs='-Xmx4g -XX:+UseG1GC' \
  2>&1 | tee /tmp/claudepy-android-assemble.log
```

**Failure triage matrix:**

| Symptom in log | Likely cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `Unresolved reference:` | Missing import / typo | Read the file, check imports, re-run |
| `Could not resolve all files for configuration` | Maven/Gradle dependency unavailable | Check `repositories {}`, network, `--refresh-dependencies` |
| `Out of memory` / `GC overhead limit` | JVM too small | Raise `-Xmx` to `6g`, restart Gradle daemon |
| `Manifest merger failed` | Conflicting `<application>` attributes | Open merged manifest at `{{module}}/build/intermediates/merged_manifests/{{variant}}/AndroidManifest.xml` |
| `Duplicate class` | Two libraries pull same artifact | `./gradlew :{{module}}:dependencies` → exclude transitive |
| `Lint found errors` | Lint check broke build | `./gradlew :{{module}}:lint{{variant^}}` → open `lint-results-{{variant}}.html` |

Abort the cycle and return triage if assemble fails. Do NOT proceed to install.

---

## Phase 3 — Install 📲

```bash
APK=$(find {{module}}/build/outputs/apk/{{variant}} -name '*.apk' -printf '%T@ %p\n' | sort -rn | head -1 | cut -d' ' -f2)
[ -n "$APK" ] || { echo 'No APK produced'; exit 4; }
adb -s "$DEVICE" install -r -t "$APK"
```

**Install failure triage:**

| adb output | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE` | Signature mismatch with installed app | `adb uninstall <appId>` and retry |
| `INSTALL_FAILED_INSUFFICIENT_STORAGE` | Device full | `adb shell pm trim-caches 999G`; or uninstall apps |
| `INSTALL_FAILED_VERSION_DOWNGRADE` | Installed version > new APK | Bump `versionCode` in `build.gradle` |
| `INSTALL_FAILED_NO_MATCHING_ABIS` | Wrong ABI for device | Add `abiFilters` for device arch (`arm64-v8a` for most modern) |

---

## Phase 4 — Tests 🧪

Dispatch based on `{{test_scope}}`:

### `unit` (JVM only)
```bash
FILTER_ARG=''
[ '{{test_filter}}' != 'all' ] && FILTER_ARG="--tests {{test_filter}}"
./gradlew :{{module}}:test{{variant^}}UnitTest $FILTER_ARG \
  2>&1 | tee /tmp/claudepy-android-unit.log
```
Report path: `{{module}}/build/reports/tests/test{{variant^}}UnitTest/index.html`

### `instrumented` (on-device)
```bash
FILTER_ARG=''
[ '{{test_filter}}' != 'all' ] && FILTER_ARG="-Pandroid.testInstrumentationRunnerArguments.class={{test_filter}}"
./gradlew :{{module}}:connected{{variant^}}AndroidTest $FILTER_ARG \
  2>&1 | tee /tmp/claudepy-android-instrumented.log
```
Report path: `{{module}}/build/reports/androidTests/connected/{{variant}}/index.html`

### `both`
Run unit first; only run instrumented if unit passes (faster failure feedback).

### `none`
Skip — used for launch-and-observe iterations.

**Test failure triage:**

1. **Parse failures count:**
   ```bash
   grep -E '(FAILED|PASSED|SKIPPED)' /tmp/claudepy-android-*.log | tail -10
   ```
2. **Pull failure summaries:**
   ```bash
   awk '/FAILED$/{flag=1; print; next} flag && /^\s*$/ {flag=0} flag' /tmp/claudepy-android-*.log
   ```
3. **For instrumented test crashes, pull tombstone:**
   ```bash
   adb -s "$DEVICE" logcat -d AndroidRuntime:E *:S | tail -60
   ```

---

## Phase 5 — Runtime log scrape (if applicable) 📜

When `iteration_goal` mentions reproducing/observing runtime behavior, capture logcat:

```bash
PKG=$(./gradlew -q :{{module}}:printApplicationId 2>/dev/null | tail -1)
adb -s "$DEVICE" logcat -c
adb -s "$DEVICE" shell am start -n "$PKG/$(grep -oP 'android:name="\K[^"]+' {{module}}/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml | head -1)"
sleep 5
adb -s "$DEVICE" logcat -d --pid=$(adb -s "$DEVICE" shell pidof "$PKG") > /tmp/claudepy-android-runtime.log
```

Grep for these signals:
```bash
grep -E 'FATAL EXCEPTION|ANR|StrictMode|Choreographer.*Skipped' /tmp/claudepy-android-runtime.log
```

---

## Phase 6 — Triage report 📋

Return this JSON (and nothing else) so claudepy can route to the next agent:

```json
{
  "cycle_result": "pass | partial | fail",
  "phase_reached": "assemble | install | test | runtime",
  "build": {
    "variant": "{{variant}}",
    "duration_seconds": <number>,
    "warnings": <number>
  },
  "install": {
    "device_model": "<from getprop>",
    "apk_size_mb": <number>
  },
  "tests": {
    "scope": "{{test_scope}}",
    "passed": <number>,
    "failed": <number>,
    "skipped": <number>,
    "failure_names": ["<test fqn>", "..."]
  },
  "runtime": {
    "crashed": <bool>,
    "crash_class": "<exception class or empty>"
  },
  "next_action": "<one sentence — what the next claudepy turn should do>",
  "iteration_goal_met": <bool>
}
```

### Decision rules for `next_action`
- Assemble failed → "Open <first file:line from error>, apply fix, rerun cycle."
- Install failed with `INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE` → "Uninstall then retry install."
- Tests failed → "Read failing test source <first failure>, propose fix, rerun with filter."
- Runtime crashed → "Pull stacktrace, locate top-of-stack file, propose fix."
- All green and goal met → "Cycle complete — propose commit message."
- All green but goal not met → "Iterate on next sub-goal: <derive from iteration_goal>."

---

## Performance budget 🎯

This cycle should fit inside a single claudepy turn. Hard ceilings:

| Phase | Soft limit | Hard limit (abort) |
|---|---|---|
| Sanity | 5s | 15s |
| Clean | 30s | 90s |
| Assemble (incremental) | 45s | 180s |
| Install | 10s | 30s |
| Unit tests | 60s | 300s |
| Instrumented tests | 120s | 600s |
| Runtime scrape | 15s | 60s |

If any phase exceeds its hard limit, kill it and report `cycle_result: "fail"` with `phase_reached` set — claudepy will split into a sub-task.

---

## Common patterns claudepy has already proven

- **Always tee logs to `/tmp/claudepy-android-*.log`** so the next turn can grep without re-running.
- **Never run `./gradlew clean` reflexively.** It costs 30–120s and rebuilds everything; only use when the build cache is suspected corrupt.
- **Prefer `install -r -t`** (`-r` reinstall keeps data, `-t` allows test APKs). Skip `-d` (downgrade) unless explicitly required.
- **Pin `$DEVICE`** from `auto` resolution at Phase 0; do not re-query each step (devices can disappear mid-cycle and you want a consistent error, not silent target switching).
- **One filter, one variant per cycle.** Multiple variants or filters belong in separate claudepy turns.
